title: deployer: pave aws.caller.get (keyrack slot to account + arn)
description:
## .what

pave `aws.caller.get --env <env> [--org <org>]`: print the account id + caller arn of the keyrack-sourced AWS_PROFILE for one slot, as a tree, with no raw aws cli to approve.

## .why

every deployer act starts with "which account am i in, as whom?". today each consumer repo paves its own copy; the prior art lives at `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron` `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/aws.caller.get.sh` (main).

## .ask

- skill reads AWS_PROFILE from keyrack for (owner ehmpath, org, env); refuses with the exact unlock command when absent (exit 2)
- tree output: profile, account, arn; exit 1 on sts error
- integration test: refusal snapshots + one live case behind a gate
